# Young Silver Dragon (`monsters:young-silver-dragon`)
*Large dragon, lawful good* | **CR** 9 (XP 5,000; PB +4)
**AC** 18 | **HP** 168 (16d10 + 80) | **Speed** 40 ft., fly 80 ft.
**STR** 23 (+6) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 21 (+5) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 19 (+4)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +4, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +4
**Skills:** [Skill: History](../proficiencies/skill-history.md) +6, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +8, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Damage Immunities:** cold
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 18
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.
- **Cold Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 49 (11d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
- **Paralyzing Breath.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
